data.one_liner: Generates Dart code for intl messages from ARB files for localization.
data.what_it_does: Extracts translatable messages from Dart source into ARB files, then generates locale‑specific Dart libraries from those ARB files. It works with the intl package to provide runtime message lookup.
use_when: You need compile‑time generation of localized message libraries
You want to keep translation files in ARB format and integrate with intl
You prefer a CLI‑driven workflow for extracting and generating messages
avoid_when: You need hot‑reload translation updates without rebuilding
You prefer runtime‑only solutions like JSON‑based localization
You are using Flutter packages that already handle extraction (e.g., easy_localization)
strengths: Integrates tightly with the intl package
Supports code generation for null‑safe Dart
CLI tools for extraction and generation
weaknesses: Requires a build step and regeneration after each translation change
No support for hot‑reload of translations
Limited to ARB format, not JSON or other formats

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides formatting and runtime message lookup without the extra generation step

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Handles ARB/JSON translations at runtime with hot‑reload, no codegen needed

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers code generation for type‑safe localization with a more modern workflow

data.minimal_example:
dart run intl_translation:extract_to_arb --output-dir=lib/l10n lib/main.dart
dart run intl_translation:generate_from_arb --generated-file-prefix=messages lib/main.dart lib/l10n/intl_*.arb
